notes: attempt-1 was exploratory (variable inspection, no RESULT lines). Final script: fixest feols on directed dyads (dyadic_data_1-4-22.Rdata), DV party_like (0-10 mean thermometer of i's partisans toward j), regressor to_pfeml (out-party proportion women MPs, t-1), country-year (cntryyr) fixed effects, SEs clustered by cntryyr. Sample: to_prior_seats >= 4 and from_prior_seats >= 4, with seat value 999 treated as a missing code (10 dyads); listwise deletion drops 44 more with missing to_pfeml. Full model adds rile_distance_s (pre-standardized |CMP rile| distance in the data), prior_coalition and prior_opposition (the codebook lists these, not govern_together/opposition_together, as the analysis variables; a diagnostic with the concurrent dummies gives a similar to_pfeml coefficient, 1.93, printed but not scored). Gender columns use gender_disagregated_8-8-21.rds, DV = 10 - dislike, gender 2 = women, 1 = men, same controls/FE/clustering/sample rule. n_election_studies = distinct cntryyr in the full-model sample. Read the three docx codebooks and readme.rtf in the mount; no scripts or result files opened.
